Map export for ▾ ⚠ Caution, experimental!
Builds a trim map, an ECU BIN or a universal CSV file from the loaded lambda data — depending on the selected target system.
IAW16M · Source BIN
Upload the BIN currently flashed to the ECU as a ZIP file (65,536 bytes). This file is read, the map at 0xF161 is recomputed, the rest stays untouched. Return again as ZIP.
Fixed grid from the fuel map:

16 degree rows: 2.0 · 2.4 · 2.9 · 3.5 · 4.2 · 5.1 · 7.5 · 9.7 · 13 · 17 · 21 · 28 · 37 · 48 · 60 · 80°

TPS → degrees conversion
0 % and 100 % TPS in the MD-Lambda-View CSV correspond to the min and max angle of the injection map.
Correction parameters
Smoothing and outlier rejection already happen at CSV import via the stability filter — only the safety cap (MAX) and the physical monotony enforcement stay here. The target λ values come from the 2D app preset (see above: “Target λ per TPS zone”).
Rapid Bike EVO · current map
Load the currently active Rapid Bike .mpp file. The file is read, the first map is recomputed from the lambda measurement (as additive RB units on top of the base inside it), the rest of the file stays untouched. Returned as a new .mpp.
Fixed grid of the RB format (Ténéré 700):
40 RPM-Zeilen: 1400 – 11200 rpm (irregular)
8 TPS-Spalten: 0 · 5 · 10 · 20 · 40 · 60 · 80 · 95 %
No MPP loaded yet.
Correction parameters
Calculation: deviation to target λ in %, divided by “% fuel per RB unit”, clamped to ± the max change, written additively (as integer) onto the base map. Column 0 % is left untouched (overrun). The target λ values come from the 2D app preset (see below: “Target λ per TPS zone”).
Custom template
Upload an empty .pvm file that you saved in the PowerCommander software for your vehicle. The export uses the model signature and dongle ID from that file. No export is possible without a custom template. The file stays in the browser until you remove it.
No template loaded yet.
Target λ per TPS zone
TPS boundaries between zones
Linear interpolation between TPS values. These targets apply only to the export (2D, 3D and IAW16M flash); the 2D app has its own targets that stay untouched.
